entities.summary: Manuel Enrique Araujo Rodríguez was a Salvadoran politician and physician. He served as President of El Salvador from 1 March 1911 until his death on 9 February 1913 from injuries sustained in an assassination attempt. Araujo is the only Salvadoran president to have been assassinated while in office.
